description: This file defines an interface for a grain in Orleans, specifically for tracking activation and deactivation calls within unit tests.

classes.name: IActivateDeactivateWatcherGrain
classes.description: An interface extending IGrainWithIntegerKey for tracking activation and deactivation calls in Orleans grains.

methods.name: GetActivateCalls
methods.description: Retrieves a list of activation call identifiers.

methods.name: GetDeactivateCalls
methods.description: Retrieves a list of deactivation call identifiers.

methods.name: RecordActivateCall
methods.description: Records an activation call with the given identifier.

methods.name: RecordDeactivateCall
methods.description: Records a deactivation call with the given identifier.
